images.caption: Figure 1:Training human-aware language models withMind2Dialogue.Left:existing dialogue data and static persona prompting provide limited supervision for understanding users.Middle:M2D-Simgenerates user behavior and informedOracleresponses from shared evolving states.Right:M2D-Corpussupports scalable assistant training. “Ground Truth” denotes simulator-defined states withheld from students.

Figure 2:Psychology-guided simulation and privileged supervision.Left:persona profiles and scenario seeds initialize the interaction.Center:the rollout engine uses one evolving state to generate user messages andOracleresponses, with a controller varying user behavior.Below:quality checks filter trajectories.Right:retained dialogues and derived QA supervise students, with state traces withheld from their inputs.
